purpose: Plan section 3: estimate variation across independently generated training banks relative to evaluation precision for P1 and secondary contrasts.
Plan section 4: check whether development conclusions persist across noise anisotropy, noise scale and shared bias, and measure runtime for V03 sizing.
scientific_reservation: seed 20261012 and IDs scientific:00000..04999 are refused by the generator and are not generated

excluded_candidate_scientific_configurat.note: Not generated here, so it remains an unseen configuration; anisotropy ratios 2 and 8 bracket its ratio of 4. Only a label-free numerical-integration accuracy check was run on its noise covariance.

seed_rule: evaluation seed = seed_base + 10 * configuration_index; training bank k (1..K) seed = evaluation seed + k; the inner-fold seed equals the training-bank seed
selection_and_calibration: Unchanged V02 rules: minimum weighted inner-OOF clipped log loss with ties to smaller C; monotone Platt on selected OOF; nominal 95% training-recall threshold; refit on the full training bank.
evaluation: Each model is evaluated on its own configuration's evaluation bank. Iso-trained models are also evaluated on every other configuration's evaluation bank.
failure_policy: Any convergence warning, nonfinite value, failed integration check, failed exact-replay or latest-message invariance, or plan/output mismatch stops the run. Partial records are retained, no candidate or bank is dropped, and a retry gets a new run ID.
prespecified_summaries: P1, S1, S2, S3, S5 and S6 per configuration and training bank on the configuration's evaluation bank; S4 is P1 under the bias configuration.
Iso variance decomposition: between-bank SD of the six bank-level contrasts versus the scenario-level SE of the bank-averaged contrast.
Persistence: sign and position relative to the 0.02-nat margin per configuration; descriptive only.
Transfer: iso-trained contrasts on each other configuration's evaluation bank.
interpretation: Exposed development evidence for design decisions only; no confirmation, operational or orbital-validity claim.
runtime_estimate: to be filled from the preflight before fixing
